description: MODIS Thermal Activity is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Environment", published or maintained by World Bank Group. This layer presents detectable thermal activity from MODIS satellites for the last 24 hours. MODIS Global Fires is a product of The University of Maryland's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS). FIRMS integrates remote sensing and GIS technologies to deliver global MODIS hotspot/fire locations to natural resource managers and other stakeholders around the World. Coverage: the whole world. It has 2 files in MAP API, HTML. The portal files it under Environment. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
